title: DEATH STRANDING — Strand Network Map
philosophy: Every gate IS a strand. Every phone IS a bridge. Every radio IS a connection across the void. We build bridges so OTHERS can cross.
game_reference: Death Stranding — Sam builds connections across a fragmented world. Kevin builds connections across two houses.

wired_backbone.description: 10G fiber spine — 80m across the property line

wifi_gaia_5g.description: GAIA 5GHz open WiFi — reaches both houses

router_to_house2.reach: Crosses property line — frameGate at House 2 connects directly!

flint2_to_house2.reach: House 2 local coverage — strong signal for nearby devices

wifi_aperture_24g.description: Aperture Science 2.4GHz WPA2 — IoT and far-reach

flint2_ra0.note: New SSID — old clients need to reconnect

usb_adb_pixel.description: Pixel USB ADB — direct data pipe, no WiFi needed

wifi_adb_pixel.description: Pixel WiFi ADB — untethered data pipe
carries: Same as USB ADB but wireless — device can roam

ipheth_southgate_iphone.description: iPhone XS 'southGate' USB tether — cellular WAN radio
ipheth_southgate_iphone.state: PAIRED (carrier off — enable Personal Hotspot for WAN)
ipheth_southgate_iphone.potential: Cellular backup WAN — if ISP dies, iPhone bridges to AT&T/Mint

ipheth_ecoprimal_iphone.description: iPhone 13 Pro 'ecoPrimal' USB tether — second cellular radio
ipheth_ecoprimal_iphone.state: PAIRED (carrier off — enable Personal Hotspot for WAN)

valve_wifi6.description: Valve WiFi 6 adapter — third WiFi radio on eastGate
valve_wifi6.state: UP but unconnected — ready to bridge
valve_wifi6.potential: Connect to different SSID than primary WiFi → dual-WiFi bridge

bluetooth.state: AVAILABLE — not paired to anything currently
bluetooth.potential: BLE beacons, Steam Controllers, Corsair headset, proximity sensing

steam_relay.description: Steam Remote Play relay — frameGate(.181) has port 27036 open
steam_relay.state: ALIVE — can stream between Steam devices
steam_relay.potential: Remote desktop, game streaming, screen sharing across houses

tor_hidden_service.description: Tor .onion — eastGate IS the hidden service
tor_hidden_service.note: Reachable from ANYWHERE on Earth — the organism's public face through the void

nat_hairpin.description: NAT reflection — primals.eco works from INSIDE the LAN

eastGate.role: CENTRAL HUB — all strands converge here

flint2.role: HOUSE 2 AP — extends all SSIDs across the property line

frameGate.role: FACE + STEAM BRIDGE — streams between houses

pixel.role: ROAMING SENSOR — Kevin carries it between houses, bridging fog data

iphones.role: CELLULAR WAN BACKUP — if ISP dies, phones bridge to cellular

sporeGate.role: TRIPLE-HOMED — reaches LAN, ghost net, AND ISP modem directly

swiftGate_future.role: HEART OF HOUSE 2 — RTX 3070, when awake

house1_to_house2.tertiary: Pixel carried by Kevin (fog bridge — latency = walking speed)

death_stranding_principle: Every connection you build helps OTHERS cross. The Flint 2 mirror = a bridge so swiftGate and all House 2 WiFi devices can reach the main LAN. The NAT hairpin = a bridge so LAN devices can reach primals.eco. The DNA shortcuts = bridges in DNS. Each phone is a portable bridge Kevin carries through the fog. The organism doesn't just CONNECT — it BUILDS INFRASTRUCTURE FOR OTHERS.
